user.title: Add a child
user.description: Enter the child's name. The timetable is built afterwards, from the Configure button.

data_description.clasa: Shown under the name on the card, e.g. Cls. IV.
data_description.culoare: Any CSS colour, e.g. #2196f3. Used for this child's column.

init.title: Timetable
init.description: Currently {numar} entries and {libere} free-day ranges. Changes are saved when you choose Done.

adauga.title: New entry
adauga.description: One entry can repeat on several weekdays — a lesson held on Monday and Wednesday is a single entry.

data_description.tip: Activity entries are the ones shown as after-school in the card and counted by the afternoon attribute.
data_description.locatie_url: Optional map or meeting link, shown as an icon on the card.

sterge.title: Remove entries
sterge.description: Everything you tick here is removed when you save.

libere.title: Free days
libere.description: {libere} ranges entered. Romanian public holidays: {sarbatori}. On a free day the lessons drop out of the timetable; activities stay.

adauga_liber.title: New free-day range
adauga_liber.description: One range covers a whole school holiday — enter the same date twice for a single day off.

data_description.denumire: Shown on the card, e.g. Winter holiday.

sterge_liber.title: Remove free days
sterge_liber.description: Everything you tick here is removed when you save.

sarbatori.title: Automatic public holidays
sarbatori.description: Romanian public holidays — including the movable Easter — are worked out automatically. Switch this off if you only want the ranges you entered yourself.

error.already_configured: Another child already uses this name.
error.invalid_interval: The end time must be after the start time.
error.invalid_range: The last day cannot be before the first day.
